aboutGame.title: What is Catch a Plane?
paragraphs: Catch a Plane is a Roblox incremental simulator from Oi_iO. You sprint down a runway, jump onto a passing plane, and hold on while your grip meter drains; every completed ride feeds strength training, glove upgrades, gear boxes, and trophies.

The loop is simple to learn and deep enough to plan around. Train grip to hold longer, upgrade gloves to grab faster and heavier aircraft, open gear boxes for jetpacks, parachutes, and Gravity Wings, then reach the finish to earn trophies and unlock new worlds.

items.question: What is Catch a Plane?
items.answer: Catch a Plane is a free-to-play Roblox incremental simulator from Oi_iO. You jump onto passing planes, hold on while your grip meter drains, train strength, upgrade gloves, open gear boxes, and reach the finish to unlock new worlds.

items.question: How do you catch a plane in Catch a Plane?
items.answer: Watch the runway for a full spawn cycle, jump as a plane passes, and latch on. Start with the slowest, lowest aircraft in Catch a Plane so you can hold for a complete route and build grip progress.

items.question: What should you upgrade first in Catch a Plane?
items.answer: Train grip strength until you can hold easy planes for a full route, then buy the first glove tiers. Gloves in Catch a Plane control grab speed and plane weight, while strength determines how long you stay attached.

items.question: Does Catch a Plane have working codes?
items.answer: Yes. The official Catch a Plane Roblox description lists oiio10k as a gift code. Enter it in lowercase in the shop, store, or settings panel and confirm the redemption.

items.question: How do you unlock new worlds in Catch a Plane?
items.answer: Reach the finish of a Catch a Plane run to earn trophies. Trophies unlock new worlds with different aircraft, layouts, and reward ceilings, so finish consistent runs whenever the route is within reach.

items.question: Is Catch a Plane free to play on Roblox?
items.answer: Yes. Catch a Plane is free to play on Roblox, and you can launch it from the official game page with a Roblox account.
